internal.title: Accounting Service Incident: Kafka Consumer Lag High
internal.body:
At 11:45 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high Kafka consumer lag in the accounting service. The lag reached 5200 records, accompanied by an elevated error ratio of 0.12 and increased p95 latency of 0.25 seconds, indicating a queue backlog causing processing delays and errors.

Diagnosis confirmed the queue backlog as the root cause. At 12:05 UTC, a mitigation action was approved and executed to disable the kafkaQueueProblems flag, which led to recovery and normalization of the Kafka consumer lag metric.

The incident was resolved promptly with no further impact observed after mitigation.

external.title: Intermittent Processing Delays in Accounting Service
external.body: Between 11:45 and 12:05 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced intermittent delays in processing transactions due to a backlog in the accounting service's message queue. The issue was identified and resolved quickly, restoring normal service operation. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
